invariants: Keep every original protection baseline, dependency declaration and prior review reference. No checksum refresh or automatic acceptance of source or migration approvals.
Save/reject/confirm append strict immutable revisions. Raw provider artifacts, normalized source, original asset rows and old confirmations are never overwritten or deleted.

New review writes require exact ENABLE_ACQUISITION_REVIEW_WRITES=true. A current member, current policy and owned exact target are required on every read/write/recovery. Workspace, actor/member, parent, job and source locks use a consistent order.

Whole-state CAS includes active exact-consumer links; pending drafts retain their starting link identity. Fixed operation UUIDs, request hashes, transactional audit readback and committed binding hashes prevent late drafts and unknown responses from being blindly replayed.

Image recovery durably prepares before a single PUT, preserves exact original bytes and validates full bounded image decoding. Completion/check/cancel use the original UUID, remain available when new writes are disabled, and never repeat the PUT. Private S3/OSS only; no storage fallback, page crawl or arbitrary browser URL.
Manual confirmations have isCurrent=0, preserving global ASIN cache semantics. Only exact consumer links with the complete source hash become active; old links and source history remain.

Publication checks actual target InnoDB engines before the first target write. Confirmations, target projection, link changes and final receipts share the same transaction and complete ACK/readback checks.

Images become a new private versioned KB set. Old sets, images, tags and AI are not replaced. KB listing/product records only bind a reviewed source reference; existing generated copy, human analysis and review state remain unchanged.

Competitor source changes preserve old AI and summaries and invalidate affected comparison approvals transactionally. Image-workflow subjects append; active source is required for selection/model input, and precisely linked superseded versions are read-only history.

Durable source readers replay source/revision/assets/confirmation/audit/links without minting authority from plain stored JSON or a browser DTO. Unverified manual images are not signed through detail, thumbnails, waterfall or knowledge-export selection.
